title: MalAlgoQA: Pedagogical Evaluation of Counterfactual Reasoning in Large Language Models and Implications for AI in Education

task.subset_rule: paper-defined split: Math questions (807, Table 2); AIA setting feeds the correct answer choice as {choice}
task.approximation: None beyond the unprinted formatting of the rationale list.

items.source: github.com/luffycodes/MalAlgoQA-Dataset (README only; the dataset is released on request through a Google Form)

fields.options: answer choices A-D with their rationales (best reading)
fields.label: rationale matching the given choice (best reading)

prompt.system: Provide step-by-step reasoning to determine the answer rationale that corresponds to the given choice for the question. Then, provide your answer in the specified JSON format.

placeholders.question: items.input
placeholders.choice: the correct answer choice (AIA); the incorrect choices give the MIA cell
placeholders.formatted_rationales: the four rationales labelled A-D (formatting not printed)

prompt.source_location: Table 5 (CoT prompt for Malgorithm Identification; the 'Provide step-by-step reasoning. Show the steps.' sentence is the CoT addition)
prompt.verbatim: full (the doubled braces in the JSON block are literal braces, not slots)

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: AIA = share of math questions where the selected rationale letter is the rationale of the correct choice
metric.original_location: Table 6, block 'GPT 4o Math', row '0 CoT', column AIA

open_points: The dataset is distributed only on request via a Google Form linked from github.com/luffycodes/MalAlgoQA-Dataset; someone must request and receive it (no public mirror found).
Rationale-list format and the 'Choice' field content must be taken from the received data (not printed).
notes: MIA (66.10) needs the three incorrect choices per question (about three calls per item). || [hook pass 2026-09-07] no hook possible (data gated).
